title.title: Update & Next Steps
title.body: Where we are, what's coming, and how we get to production — a clear-eyed view of the road ahead.

phases.label: Now
phases.title: Hardening & Positioning
items: Real flight, weather data, and PSS ingestion prep in place.
Legal groundwork ongoing with our lawyer.
Refining branding, sales approach, and pitch strategy.

phases.label: ~2 Months
phases.title: POC Phase
items: Partner with an airline to refine real-world use cases.
Test with UAT data — no live customer data yet.
Legal discussions continue. Hosting stays on Supabase / Vercel.

phases.label: Post-POC
phases.title: Production Preparation
items: Developers and SREs migrate infrastructure to AWS.
Legal and commercial terms finalised with partner airline.
